messages:
maya: opened a focused PR to unify streaming retry + 429/timeouts guidance across SDKs. intent: one clear resume pattern + one safe full-retry fallback. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4891 :mag:
jordan: can you bullet the developer-facing prescription? we need something short for the migration note and the changelog blurb.
maya: Sure. bullets in PR: 1) prefer resumable streaming using resume_token checkpoints; 2) if resume unsupported, use idempotency-key + Retry-After-aware exponential backoff; 3) surface .retry_after and .retryable on SDK errors.
sam: I'll add compact node/python/ruby snippets (<=10 lines). keep them copy/pasteable. also propose a tiny table for Retry-After precedence: server-specified > client-circuit-breaker > hard cap.
eli: QA: add a smoke that injects a 429 mid-stream, returns Retry-After once, then accepts resume. we had a regression where clients ignored Retry-After.
maya: adding mocha + pytest smoke files under docs/snippets/tests/stream-resume. tests will assert respect for Retry-After header and that resume_token is sent back.
jordan: docs prose should explicitly warn about duplicate side-effects and cost inflation if clients retry without idempotency. show header example: X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>. include sample curl for full-request retry path.
sam: pushed ruby snippet to branch:
```ruby
# resume example
client.stream(resume_token: token) do |chunk|
  process(chunk)
end
# on 429 -> sleep jittered backoff then client.resume(token)
```
eli: looks good. remember to assert metrics emitted: resumed_stream and resumed_after_retry_after. ops wants those to help debug customer issues.
maya: filed SDK issue #1001 to standardize error attributes and linked it in PR. added short migration note for teams using implicit SDK retries.
docs-bot: preview build: https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/4891  snippets render for node/python/ruby once tests pass. please add changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
maya: will add changelog blurb and request final review from @jordan + @sam after CI. ETA EOD. :rocket:
